core_struggle: Their best friend from hostel died in an accident last month, and while everyone else has moved on, they are still alone with the loss.
mirror: You open the chat every night, and the silence on the other side is what is breaking you.

queries.hook: The ache of a bond that ended too soon, and the loneliness of being the only one who has not let it go. I'm grieving someone I loved.
queries.diagnose: Grief is love with nowhere to go; the heart aches because what came together was real, and now it has been torn apart.
queries.steady: What was real does not vanish; the bond you shared is still yours, even if the body is not.
queries.act: Let the grief have its time; speak the name of what you lost, and let the love you have for them find a new place in you.
queries.story: A young person who lost their closest companion and found that love does not end with the body, only with the silence around it.

weeks: The bond that does not vanish
bridge: The chat you open every night is grief with nowhere to go. The texts call it love that has lost its home.
week_thesis: From the night you open the chat to the morning you can let the love move, seven days of grief that are given their due.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the ache and the loneliness, named without rushing you.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the grief is the love, and the chat is where it has been trapped.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what was real does not vanish, and the bond is still yours.
week_beats.act: You try speaking the name of what you lost, and letting the love find a new place in you.
week_beats.story: A young person who lost their closest companion and found that love does not end with the body, only with the silence around it.

insight: Everyone else has moved on in a week, and you are still alone with the loss. The chat you open is love that has nowhere to go.
seat: a student who lost their closest friend and has been left to grieve alone
